newsitem.title: INDIA: At least one killed in Kashmir blast.
newsitem.headline: At least one killed in Kashmir blast.

text.p: At least one person was killed and five were injured in a powerful blast on Wednesday in Srinagar, the summer capital of troubled Jammu and Kashmir state, the United News of India (UNI) quoted police as saying.
Officials told UNI the blast occurred near the heavily guarded guest house for state legislators.
The bomb was planted in a car near the front gate of the guest house, the news agency said.
It said the injured included two policewomen.
It was the fourth blast since a new government, led by the state's National Conference party, assumed office after last month's local assembly polls.
